The <b>Surgeon's Key</b> is an [[Items (Silksong)#Keys|item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
Used to open the sluice gate located west of the bottom of the [[Whiteward]] lift, allowing access to [[the Unravelled]].<ref>Inspecting the lock: <i>"An ornate lock mechanism with a keyhole at its centre."</i></ref>

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Surgeon Key Use.png!Location in the Whiteward where the Surgeon's Key can be used
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Surgeon's Key 01.png!Lock location
}}

== How to Acquire ==
Found in the Whiteward, past a hidden path in the ceiling above the area with the [[Mortician]]s. In the western room of this area, [[Clawline]] must be used to open a shaft, which releases debris and a [[Surgeon]]'s corpse holding the key.
